tasks.label: Bootstrap Python Dev Environment
tasks.command: PYTHON_BIN="$(command -v python3.12 || true)"; if [ -z "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then echo 'Error: python3.12 was not found on PATH. Install Python 3.12 so editor type checking matches the Docker runtime.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python ]; then echo 'Bootstrapping .venv...'; "$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv ${workspaceFolder}/.venv; elif ! ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12) else 1)'; then echo 'Error: .venv exists but is not Python 3.12. Remove .venv and rerun this task.'; exit 1; fi; ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e "${workspaceFolder}[app,runtime,test]"; PATH="${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin:$PATH" ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -m prisma generate
tasks.detail: Create/update the Python 3.12 .venv editor environment with app/runtime/test deps and generated Prisma client

tasks.label: Run All Tests
tasks.detail: Local gate runner: README sync, Python (compile/Ruff/inline-imports/jscpd/changed-file mypy via selector/pyright/pytest), frontend Prettier format check, changed-file frontend ESLint with warnings as errors via selector, and frontend Vite build. Uses Docker build targets for environment parity. Note: docker compose manifest validation is not included (run manually if changing .env.example or compose files).

tasks.label: Lint All Files
tasks.command: docker build --progress=plain --target python-ruff-style-check -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/Dockerfile ${workspaceFolder} && docker build --progress=plain --target python-ruff-check -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/Dockerfile ${workspaceFolder} && docker build --progress=plain --target python-mypy-check -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/Dockerfile ${workspaceFolder} && docker build --progress=plain --target python-pyright-check -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/Dockerfile ${workspaceFolder} && docker build --progress=plain --target frontend-format-check -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/Dockerfile ${workspaceFolder} && docker build --progress=plain --target frontend-lint -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/Dockerfile --build-arg ESLINT_SCOPE=all ${workspaceFolder}
tasks.detail: Read-only full-repository lint gate: Ruff format/import/inline-imports, Ruff check, mypy, pyright, frontend Prettier check, and frontend ESLint with warnings as errors via Docker targets.

tasks.label: Start Development Stack
tasks.command: if [ ! -f ${workspaceFolder}/.env ]; then echo 'Error: .env file not found. Copy .env.example to .env and configure it.'; exit 1; fi && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
tasks.detail: Start Ragtime development stack with hot-reload

tasks.label: Rebuild Development Stack
tasks.command: if [ ! -f ${workspaceFolder}/.env ]; then echo 'Error: .env file not found. Copy .env.example to .env and configure it.'; exit 1; fi && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up --force-recreate

tasks.label: Fix All Lint Issues
tasks.command: export PATH="${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin:${PATH}"; ruff check --fix . && ruff format . && bash tests/check_frontend_format.sh --write && cd "${workspaceFolder}" && ./ragtime/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --config ./ragtime/frontend/.prettierrc.json --write "ragtime/**/*.ts" "ragtime/**/*.tsx"
tasks.detail: Python: Ruff lint fix + Ruff format. Frontend: Prettier format + ESLint autofix.
